# In Practise

> > In Practise provides AI-powered transcription services and primary research tools for professional investors and hedge funds.

The platform offers IP Transcribe, an intelligent transcription service with GDPR/HIPAA compliance, human review capabilities, and speaker diarization. In Practise serves professional investors conducting primary research through executive calls and interviews.

## Key Topics

- IP Transcribe
- AI-powered transcription
- GDPR compliance
- HIPAA compliance
- Human review and proofing
- Speaker diarization
- Professional investors
- Hedge funds
- Primary research
- Executive calls
- Word DOCX and Markdown export
- Cost reduction
- In Practise Library
- Intelligent transcription
- Contact sales and demos
